pr_title: Add dynamic unit of measurement support for Overkiz sensor
pr_body:

<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Until now we hardcoded the unit of measurement. Thanks to this modification, we now read the value from Overkiz when exposed.
This unit is returned by Overkiz as attribute for the device. This attribute can be named `MeasuredValueType` or `<state_name>MeasuredValueType`. This last case happens when a device contains several sensors.

To avoid any regression, I’ve added the existing unit as default value.

Should this instead be added as a `UnitOfVolumeFlowRate` so it can be converted automatically?

Unit conversion is based on `device_class`, so maybe the unifi integration sensor doesn't have a device class set...
